request: A pytest regression appeared after a recent change: assertion rewriting can crash when the first expression in a test module is a number because that expression is treated like a module docstring. Reproduce the issue, identify the owning rule in assertion rewriting, fix the general cause, and add regression protection. Do not special-case only the literal value from the reproducer.
manual_checks: The explanation distinguishes the proximate crash from the incorrect docstring-classification rule.
The fix generalizes to non-string constant expressions rather than hardcoding one numeric value.
runtime_notes: Historical external case; requires network access for checkout and a Python environment compatible with this pytest revision.

request: Pytest can reuse a cached result for identical skipif/xfail condition strings even when the same expression is evaluated in different module namespaces. Reproduce the cross-module state leak, identify why the cache key is invalid for dynamic evaluation, fix the owning rule, and add regression coverage without special-casing the sample modules.
manual_checks: The root cause identifies cross-namespace caching rather than treating the skipped test as the defect.
The regression test proves the same condition text can evaluate differently in different namespaces.
runtime_notes: Historical external case; requires network access for checkout and a Python environment compatible with this pytest revision.
